en: The Hole, 309 Days to the Bloodiest Tragedy
orig: Lobang Buaya: 309 Hari Sebelum Tragedi Berdarah
plotEn:
The Hole, 309 Days to the Bloodiest Tragedy (Indonesian: Lobang Buaya: 309 Hari Sebelum Tragedi Berdarah) is a 2026 Horror thriller film written and directed by Hanung Bramantyo. The film, set in 1960s Indonesia, centers on the village of Lubang Buaya, where a series of unexplained murders occur on the 30th of each month. Victims are found with holes and strange messages written on their faces. 
The film is inspired by the theories surrounding 30 September Movement of 1965 events at Lubang Buaya
